ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: Further north the road climbs into a fog so thick you can barely see your own hand.
Battles up there are tricky. In fog, moves miss far more often than you'd think.

trainer.name: Fabian
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Fabian: Ha! You walked right past me. A ninja hides where nobody thinks to look!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Fabian: Next time I'll hide in taller grass. Much taller.

trainer.name: Brennan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Brennan: The grass rustled, and you never guessed it was me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Brennan: My hiding is perfect. It's my battling that needs work.

trainer.name: Bruce
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Bruce: Surprise! A ninja's first lesson: always spring from the grass!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Bruce: A ninja's second lesson is losing with dignity. I'm still working on that one.

trainer.name: Teri & Tia
trainer.dialogueBefore: Teri: Tia and I picked the sweetest Pokémon we could find. Want to see them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Teri: Being sweet isn't enough on its own, is it, Tia?

trainer.name: Teri & Tia
trainer.dialogueBefore: Tia: Two of us, two Pokémon! You won't know which way to look!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tia: We'll train them to be sweet AND strong, Teri.

trainer.name: Kahlil
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: Baby Pokémon are small, but never take them lightly. Watch!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: They'll grow and evolve one day. Then we'll see who wins.

trainer.name: Amber
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Breeder Amber: I looked after their Eggs myself, and now they're ready for a real battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Breeder Amber: There, there. You were all very brave.

trainer.name: Ava & Matt
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ava: Pa and I ride out along this road every day. Fancy a battle at a gallop?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ava: We'll ride home at a walk, then. Won't we, Pa?

trainer.name: Ava & Matt
trainer.dialogueBefore: Matt: We've raised Ponyta on our farm for years, Ava and I. Here we come!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Matt: Well, I'll be. You handled that like an old hand.

trainer.name: Marco
trainer.dialogueBefore: Rancher Marco: On a farm, a good Ponyta is worth ten tractors. Let me show you why!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Rancher Marco: Ha! My Ponyta needs a few more laps of the field, I reckon.

signs.signboard_cafe_cabin:
Café Cabin
Rest your feet and warm up before the climb into the fog.
